title: Harry's Education
description: Adds chemistry and real-world science into Minecraft!
body:
Harry’s Education is a Minecraft mod designed to bring real-world science into your gameplay!

This mod introduces new elements such as Sodium, Lithium, and more, along with custom blocks, items, and mechanics that let you explore chemistry in a fun and interactive way.

 

🔹 Features:

Adds new elements like Sodium, Lithium, and other real-world materials.

Educational but fun — great for learning while playing.

New crafting recipes and unique interactions inspired by chemistry.

Perfect for classrooms, modpacks, or anyone curious about science in Minecraft.

Bring learning into Minecraft and make your world both fun and educational!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WARNING!

This Mod is in Alpha stage, and might have missing textures or missing features.

This mod ONLY works in creative for now and soon it will be survival friendly.
